- File: scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py
  Line or code reference: check_review_runs docstring "Reads:" paragraph (around lines 354-368)
  Problem: The function-level docstring describes each API call with its own parenthetical "(1 call, newest 100 runs)" rather than stating a single total budget. A quick reader can miscount (the cross-pollination summary shows gemini-3.1-flash-lite flagged this in the most recent review round with confidence 5; the implementation makes 5 calls per ready PR: 1 head-branch + 1 internal-review.yml dispatch + 3 unbound workflow dispatches, but the docstring parses as separate "(1 call …)" groups with no total).
  Why it fails at runtime: Does not fail at runtime. The module-level docstring (around line 70-75) and the caller docstring in scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py both state the totals clearly ("1 head-branch runs read and 4 workflow_dispatch runs reads"), so the API-hygiene contract is preserved at those surfaces. But the function-level docstring is the API-hygiene anchor for future contributors reasoning about the sweep's per-PR cost, and the latest round's reading of it shows the wording can mislead a §15 audit.
